title: SwiftSage: A Generative Agent with Fast and Slow Thinking for Complex Interactive Tasks

layout.note: Four framed columns side by side with the method name printed under each; every column is a top-down stack of prompt cards, LLM box and action box, SwiftSage in a purple frame with extra blocks (Small LM at the top, action buffer at the bottom). The right fifth of the canvas is empty.

lesson: Compare agent or prompting designs by drawing each as the same top-down stack of prompt cards, LLM box and output, then colour only the span or box that differs; header tabs say how often each block runs, which shows the cost difference without numbers.
